name: Negative attention
plain: Adds a term to the positive prompt's attention scores from the difference between positive and negative attention outputs. It expects a cond tokens doubled by concat.
math: w_p,w_n = q·kᵀ, q·k_nᵀ (scale 1/√d). Δ = softmax(w_p)v − softmax(w_n)v_n; D = Linear(dim→S)(Δ); A = softmax(w_p + D·strength); A·v.

props.hook: set_model_attn2_replace across blocks, plus post-CFG NaN interrupt
props.architectures: Any UNet attn2 with ≥2× 77 tokens; else falls through.

label: from code
surprise: Creates a new untrained torch.nn.Linear on every attention call, so the projection D is random each call and consumes global RNG.
